name: Hanekura Asaki
source:
Hobby: Billiards, Touring

A 2nd year at Shoukei Academy.
His family owns a large bank in the city, Hanekura Bank.
He was raised to take over the business but he rebelled against that strict upbringing and ran out of the house to start living with [url=/c46075]Kazuya[/url].
He likes playing billiards and biking, but he doesn't really like women.
